name: Toromont Industries Ltd.

Significant enclosure (AVL) order booked for delivery substantially in 2027; backlog ~C$2.9bn at Sep-2026 vs C$1.3bn a year earlier

evidence: Product support (parts & service) on installed Cat base grows steadily [S1]

B.rationale: Exclusive dealership territories plus installed-base service are a strong, durable moat.

C.rationale: Scale in territory produces strong returns.

D.rationale: Moderate organic runway within fixed territories.

evidence: AVL purchase-commitment expense C$82.5m YTD signals high price for remaining stake [S1]
G.rationale: Conservative; AVL deal increases DC concentration and earn-out-like cost.

evidence: Backlog doubled on enclosure order for 2027 [S1]
I2.rationale: ESTIMATE: data-centre/power-gen related revenue likely 13-20% and rising; AVL end markets assumed DC-heavy (not disclosed).

evidence: AVL purchase-commitment expense through P&L (C$82.5m YTD) [S1]
K.rationale: Clean core; AVL commitment adds volatility.

ai.notes: AVL (power-generation enclosures) was ~13% of Q3 2026 revenue (FACT) and booked a large 2027 order that roughly doubled backlog; power systems revenue +108%. End-market split of AVL not disclosed; INFERENCE: largely data-centre backup power. Estimated AI/DC-related revenue 13-20% and rising into 2027.

sector_specific.notes: ai_dc_pct = ESTIMATE (AVL ~13% of Q3 revenue plus part of Cat power systems). construction: construction is a major Equipment Group market (equipment +11%, product support +3%) - share not disclosed. Acquisition contribution not separately disclosed; AVL growth is inorganic vs 2024 base.

gates.notes: G5 -> B: estimated AI/DC-linked revenue ~13-20% (AVL enclosures + power systems) and backlog doubled on an enclosure order for 2027 - needs disclosure of AVL end markets. G3 -> B: single large enclosure order (customer not disclosed) may make one customer material in 2027; plus Caterpillar dealership dependence. G1 net cash.

bull_points: Exclusive Caterpillar territories with growing product support (+14%) and ROCE 26.7% (S1)
bear_points: Growth increasingly reliant on AVL data-centre power enclosures - an AI-capex exposure inconsistent with diversification (S1)
Equipment sales cyclical (mining, construction, material handling -36%) (S1)
AVL purchase-commitment revaluations hit earnings (C$82.5m YTD) (S1)
thesis_breakers: Disclosed data-centre share of revenue above 30%
Product support growth below 3% for a full year
ROE below 15% for two consecutive years
